scope: Quantify native passive wet-fault transfer and a current-limited shunt candidate before selecting a gate-control circuit.

checks.name: candidate dry gain perturbation within0.1dB screen
candidate mute dry gain change within0.1dB screen

limitations: Source changes are imposed fault screens, not predictions from an op-amp model outside its operating range.
33V means a change between opposite16.5V limits, represented incrementally in the linear network; it is not a33V supply.
JFET100ohm and5pF are25C/limited-bias datasheet test values, not full-temperature or large-signal guarantees.
Shunt closure times are assumed scenarios, not qualified comparator/optocoupler/JFET or relay timing.
Transient fixture excludes gate-charge feedthrough, contact bounce, tube-grid dynamics, output transformer and loudspeaker.
The native MIX_OUT load includes R24. Additional resistive loading is a sensitivity test, not the real bootstrapped PI input.
Off capacitance is included in AC only; fault transient calculation is the one-capacitor low-frequency model.
No perceptual silence, full fault protection, exact purchasing, native CAD or fabrication approval follows.
